narration: For {identical_months} months the two lives were the same. In month {fork_month} a card turned up unasked, and you chose {real_choice} while the ghost took {ghost_choice}. {first_bar_apart} was the first score to part, that same month, and the ghost's money stayed above yours for {ghost_ahead_months} months. At the layoff in month {layoff_month}, the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. By month {end_month}, the ghost had {net_worth_gap}. The ghost's room to last through a stretch with no pay sat {safety_gap}.
